name: Affinda Resume Parser
tagline: AI resume and CV parsing API with structured skills and experience extraction
description: Affinda provides an AI-powered document parsing API specializing in resumes and CVs. It extracts structured fields such as contact info, work experience, education, skills, and certifications from uploaded documents, returning JSON suitable for ATS, recruiting, and HR workflows.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (self-serve signup)

use_cases: parse a resume PDF into structured JSON
extract skills and work history from a CV
normalize candidate contact info from uploaded resumes
batch-parse applicant CVs for ATS ingestion
